request.message: Did Coca-Cola deliver on its 2023 capital-spending outlook? Compare its stated expectation with actual cash PP&E spending, and compare 2023–2024 revenue and net income with PepsiCo.

data.response:
# Coca-Cola 2023 Capital-Spending and Peer Performance Investigation

**Mixed**

Coca-Cola stated an expectation for 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [E99ee479756](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm). Actual 2023 cash property, plant, and equipment spending was $1,852,000,000 [Ec2044c0f84](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html), which aligns closely with the approximate target. Comparing revenues and net income for 2023 and 2024 with PepsiCo shows differing operational scales and annual financial movements [E8c4dbf8870](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [Eb75fe83c0e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [Eda8480bf87](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [Ed30cf1352f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [E865feb9700](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E9744fa4ae7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E596b8dc1bb](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [E38d008ae39](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html).

## Numbers on record

KO revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $47.061 billion [Eda8480bf87](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $45.754 billion for 2023-12-31 [E8c4dbf8870](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $10.631 billion [Ed30cf1352f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), down from $10.714 billion for 2023-12-31 [Eb75fe83c0e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $2.064 billion [Ea851306827](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $1.852 billion for 2023-12-31 [Ec2044c0f84](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of February 21, 2023, in its 2022 Form 10-K, Coca-Cola stated that it expected 2023 capital expenditures to be approximately $1.9 billion [E99ee479756](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm). Historical financial results for Coca-Cola were available through the 2022 fiscal year, showing revenues of $43,004,000,000 and net income of $9,542,000,000 for the period ended 2022-12-31 [Ef7b942573c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [Ed53f2fa0fc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html).

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ended 2023-12-31, Coca-Cola reported actual cash payments to acquire property, plant, and equipment of $1,852,000,000 [Ec2044c0f84](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). For the same 2023 period, Coca-Cola reported revenues of $45,754,000,000 and net income of $10,714,000,000 [E8c4dbf8870](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [Eb75fe83c0e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). For fiscal 2024 (period ended 2024-12-31), Coca-Cola reported revenues of $47,061,000,000, net income of $10,631,000,000, and capex of $2,064,000,000 [Eda8480bf87](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [Ed30cf1352f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [Ea851306827](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html).

## The peer test

For fiscal 2023 (period ended 2023-12-30), PepsiCo reported revenue of $91,471,000,000 and net income of $9,074,000,000 [E865feb9700](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E9744fa4ae7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html). For fiscal 2024 (period ended 2024-12-28), PepsiCo reported revenue of $91,854,000,000 and net income of $9,578,000,000 [E596b8dc1bb](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [E38d008ae39](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). PepsiCo operates on a slightly different fiscal calendar ending on the last Saturday of December, and annual capex figures for PepsiCo were not retrieved under supported XBRL tags [E5b96e2debc], precluding a direct peer capex comparison.

## Cross-examination

Management's statement regarding 2023 capital expenditures was framed as an approximation rather than a strict binding guarantee [E99ee479756](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm). The actual outcome of $1.852 billion [Ec2044c0f84](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) is near this estimate, but entity-wide annual totals do not verify unobservable funding sources or segment allocations. An investor should ask next: What specific regional or bottling infrastructure projects drove the increase in capital expenditures from $1.484 billion in 2022 to over $2.064 billion by 2024 [Eb2aa45cd58](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [Ea851306827](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html)?

## Limits

- Annual capex observations for PepsiCo were not retrieved under the supported XBRL tags, limiting peer capital-spending comparisons.
- Macroeconomic data and segment-level operational breakdowns remain outside the vintage scope.
